<blog>
# WUN Gazette — Project Overview

## 1. Project Introduction

**WUN Gazette** is a React-based promotional and interactive landing page for **World Union Nation (WUN)**, described as a digital nation where a single passport unlocks currency, chats, peer trade, open voting, and a 3D orbital station called Orbita.

### Purpose Statement

The project serves as:

- A **marketing and onboarding showcase** for the WUN ecosystem.
- An **interactive explainer** demonstrating how WUNCoin, Neutron Graph, friend bonuses, and modules work together.
- A **brand experience** centered around space/nation imagery, animated emblems, and live-feeling network visualizations.

### Core Goals and Objectives

| Goal | How It Appears in Code |
| --- | --- |
| Communicate WUN’s identity | Hero copy, brand lockup, emblem SVG, and footer company info |
| Explain core systems | Signal tuner, Neutron graph card, module action deck |
| Encourage early adoption | Sign-up/sign-in links, “Get Your Passport” CTAs, friend bonus simulator |
| Provide an immersive UI | Canvas starfield, animated SVG emblem, tilt-reactive passport card |

### Target Audience

- Early visitors exploring WUN before or during registration.
- Community members who need a clear, visual explanation of passports, WUNCoin, Neutron, and Orbita.
- Users evaluating whether to join the platform through the landing page.

---

## 2. Technical Architecture

### High-Level Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  Browser["Browser"] --> HTML["index.html"]
  HTML --> Vite["Vite Build Tool"]
  Vite --> MainTSX["src/main.tsx"]
  MainTSX --> AppTSX["src/App.tsx"]
  AppTSX --> AmbientBackdrop["AmbientBackdrop.tsx"]
  AppTSX --> EmblemCanvas["EmblemCanvas.tsx"]
  AppTSX --> NeutronGraphCard["NeutronGraphCard.tsx"]
  EmblemCanvas --> WunStarOrbit["WunStarOrbit (SVG)"]
  NeutronGraphCard --> Canvas2D["HTML Canvas 2D"]
  AmbientBackdrop --> StarField["Canvas Starfield"]
```

### Component Breakdown

At runtime, the application renders a single-page layout composed of:

1. **App** — top-level layout, sections, state, and navigation.
2. **AmbientBackdrop** — background starfield and aurora-like orbs.
3. **EmblemCanvas** — branded splash/emblem area with animated SVG.
4. **WunStarOrbit** — reusable animated SVG planet/star/ring illustration.
5. **NeutronGraphCard** — interactive canvas visualization of the Neutron network.

```mermaid
graph TD
  App["App.tsx"] --> Header["Top Navigation"]
  App --> Hero["Hero Section"]
  App --> NeutronSection["Neutron Graph Section"]
  App --> FriendsSection["Friend Bonuses Section"]
  App --> ModulesSection["Modules Deck Section"]
  App --> FAQSection["FAQ Section"]
  App --> Footer["Footer"]
  Hero --> EmblemCanvas
  EmblemCanvas --> WunStarOrbit
  NeutronSection --> NeutronGraphCard
  App --> AmbientBackdrop
```

### Design Patterns

| Pattern | Usage |
| --- | --- |
| Single-page React app | `main.tsx` mounts `<App />` inside `StrictMode`. |
| Composition over inheritance | `App` composes smaller components rather than using class hierarchies. |
| Local component state | `useState` manages signal selection, quests, callsign, module triggers, and FAQ state. |
| Ref-driven animation loops | Both `AmbientBackdrop` and `NeutronGraphCard` use `requestAnimationFrame` with refs. |
| Data-driven UI | Sections like hero signals, friend quests, modules, and FAQ are driven by constant arrays. |
| CSS + inline styles hybrid | Layout uses classes from `station.css`; motion/tilt effects use inline styles. |
| External link delegation | Authentication and constitution links are external URLs defined at the top of `App.tsx`. |

### System Relationships

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class App {
        +signalIdx
        +checkedQuests
        +callsign
        +passTilt
        +triggeredModules
        +openFaq
    }
    class AmbientBackdrop {
        +canvasRef
        +starfield loop
    }
    class EmblemCanvas {
        +activeRoomName
    }
    class WunStarOrbit {
        +period
        +className
    }
    class NeutronGraphCard {
        +selectedId
        +filterKind
        +pulseCount
    }

    App --> AmbientBackdrop : renders
    App --> EmblemCanvas : renders
    App --> NeutronGraphCard : renders
    EmblemCanvas --> WunStarOrbit : uses
```

### Data Flow

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User as User
    participant App as App State
    participant Emblem as EmblemCanvas
    participant Graph as NeutronGraphCard
    participant Canvas as Canvas 2D

    User->>+App: Click "Join" / "Sign In"
    App-->>-User: Navigate to getwun.app auth URL

    User->>+App: Toggle friend quest
    App->>App: Update checkedQuests
    App->>App: Recalculate friendshipScore & tier
    App-->>-User: Re-render passport card

    User->>+Graph: Click node or Send Impulse
    Graph->>Graph: Emit pulse particles
    Graph->>Canvas: Redraw frame
    Canvas-->>-Graph: Rendered frame

    User->>+Emblem: View animated emblem
    Emblem->>WunStarOrbit: Render SVG orbit animation
    WunStarOrbit-->>-Emblem: Animated SVG output
```

---

## 3. Key Implementation

### Main Entry Point

- **File:** `src/main.tsx`
- **Responsibility:** Creates the React root, mounts `<App />`, enables `StrictMode`, and imports global styles.

Key behavior:

- Uses `react-dom/client`’s `createRoot`.
- Wraps the app in `StrictMode`.
- Imports `station.css` for global styling.

Sources:
- [main.tsx](src/main.tsx#L1-L11)

### Root Application Component

- **File:** `src/App.tsx`
- **Responsibility:** Orchestrates the entire landing page, including hero, Neutron section, friend bonuses, modules, FAQ, and footer.

Highlights:

- Defines external URLs for sign-in, sign-up, and constitution.
- Declares data arrays for hero signals, friend quests, modules, and FAQ items.
- Manages local UI state for interactivity.
- Renders multiple semantic sections with accessible labels and roles.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  App["App.tsx"] --> Hero["Hero Section"]
  App --> Neutron["Neutron Graph Section"]
  App --> Allies["Friend Bonuses Section"]
  App --> Modules["Modules Deck Section"]
  App --> FAQ["FAQ Section"]
  App --> CTA["Final Call-to-Action"]
  App --> Footer["Site Footer"]
```

Sources:
- [App.tsx](src/App.tsx#L1-L571)

### Ambient Background Animation

- **File:** `src/AmbientBackdrop.tsx`
- **Responsibility:** Draws a moving starfield with subtle constellation lines and provides aurora orb containers.

Implementation characteristics:

- Uses a `useEffect` hook to set up a canvas animation loop.
- Generates a fixed number of star dots with position, velocity, radius, alpha, and phase.
- Updates positions each frame and draws twinkling stars plus faint connecting lines.
- Cleans up animation frames and resize listeners on unmount.

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Mounted
    Mounted --> SetupCanvas : useEffect
    SetupCanvas --> AnimationLoop : requestAnimationFrame
    AnimationLoop --> AnimationLoop : update stars
    AnimationLoop --> Unmounted : cleanup
```

Sources:
- [AmbientBackdrop.tsx](src/AmbientBackdrop.tsx#L1-L102)

### Brand Emblem and Animated SVG

- **File:** `src/EmblemCanvas.tsx`
- **Responsibility:** Renders the branded splash card and the reusable `WunStarOrbit` SVG illustration.

Key responsibilities:

- `WunStarOrbit`: builds an animated SVG scene with a star, ring, planet, atmosphere, clouds, and light/shine gradients.
- `EmblemCanvas`: wraps the orbit mark, wordmark letters, decorative shapes, and accessibility attributes.
- Respects `prefers-reduced-motion` to disable animations when requested.

```mermaid
graph TD
  EmblemCanvas["EmblemCanvas.tsx"] --> WunStarOrbit["WunStarOrbit SVG"]
  WunStarOrbit --> Gradients["Gradients & Filters"]
  WunStarOrbit --> Planet["Planet & Rings"]
  WunStarOrbit --> Star["Star Polygon"]
  WunStarOrbit --> Motion["SVG Animations"]
```

Sources:
- [EmblemCanvas.tsx](src/EmblemCanvas.tsx#L1-L378)

### Neutron Network Visualization

- **File:** `src/NeutronGraphCard.tsx`
- **Responsibility:** Renders an interactive canvas-based graph showing system nodes, citizen nodes, edges, and flowing pulses.

Core concepts:

- Nodes represent system features such as Neutron Core, Passport ID, Friend Drops, Orbita Ring, Peer Escrow, and sample citizens.
- Edges have weights and kinds: sync, reward, and trade.
- Particles flow along curved edges; clicking a node emits bursts.
- Users can filter streams by kind and select nodes to highlight connections.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  User["User Interaction"] --> Controls["Filter Pills & Pulse Button"]
  User --> CanvasClick["Canvas Node Click"]
  Controls --> State["React State"]
  CanvasClick --> State
  State --> DrawLoop["Canvas Draw Loop"]
  DrawLoop --> Edges["Curved Edges"]
  DrawLoop --> Particles["Flowing Pulses"]
  DrawLoop --> Nodes["System & Citizen Nodes"]
```

Sources:
- [NeutronGraphCard.tsx](src/NeutronGraphCard.tsx#L1-L397)

### Configuration Approach

| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | Project metadata, scripts, dependencies, and dev dependencies. |
| `vite.config.ts` | Minimal Vite configuration enabling the React plugin. |
| `tsconfig.json` | TypeScript configuration (present in repository). |
| `vercel.json` | Deployment configuration for Vercel. |
| `.gitignore` | Git ignore rules. |
| `.vercelignore` | Vercel build ignore rules. |
| `index.html` | HTML entry point for the SPA. |

#### Scripts

From `package.json`:

| Script | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `dev` | Starts the Vite development server. |
| `build` | Runs TypeScript type checking without emitting, then builds with Vite. |
| `preview` | Serves the built output locally. |
| `test:hero` | Runs the hero welcome test file using Node’s test runner. |

Sources:
- [package.json](package.json#L1-L26)
- [vite.config.ts](vite.config.ts#L1-L7)

### External Dependencies

#### Runtime Dependencies

| Dependency | Version | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `react` | ^19.2.0 | UI framework. |
| `react-dom` | ^19.2.0 | DOM rendering. |
| `lucide-react` | ^1.66.0 | Icon components used across the UI. |
| `three` | ^0.187.0 | 3D library declared as a dependency. |
| `@types/three` | ^0.187.0 | TypeScript types for Three.js. |

#### Development Dependencies

| Dependency | Version | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `@vitejs/plugin-react` | ^5.1.0 | Vite React support. |
| `typescript` | ^5.9.3 | Type checking and compilation. |
| `vite` | ^7.1.12 | Build tool and dev server. |
| `@types/react` | ^19.2.2 | React TypeScript types. |
| `@types/react-dom` | ^19.2.2 | ReactDOM TypeScript types. |

Sources:
- [package.json](package.json#L11-L24)

### Integration Points

| Integration | Location | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Authentication | `src/App.tsx` | Links to `getwun.app/auth/en?tab=signin` and `signup`. |
| Constitution | `src/App.tsx` | Links to `getwun.app/constitution/en`. |
| Privacy Policy | `public/privacy/index.html` | Static privacy policy page served under `/privacy`. |
| Terms of Use | `public/terms/index.html` | Static terms page served under `/terms`. |
| Global Styles | `src/station.css` | Imported by `main.tsx`. |
| Vercel Deployment | `vercel.json` | Deployment configuration. |

```mermaid
graph LR
  App["App.tsx"] --> Auth["getwun.app/auth"]
  App --> Constitution["getwun.app/constitution"]
  Site["WUN Gazette Site"] --> Privacy["/privacy"]
  Site --> Terms["/terms"]
```

Sources:
- [App.tsx](src/App.tsx#L19-L22)
- [App.tsx](src/App.tsx#L543-L567)

---

## 4. Key Features

### Functionality Overview

| Feature | Description | Primary File |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hero Welcome Section | Animated title, signal tuner, and call-to-action buttons. | `src/App.tsx` |
| Live Signal Tuner | Switches between WUNCoin, Neutron Graph, Friend Bonuses, and Orbita descriptions. | `src/App.tsx` |
| Animated Brand Emblem | SVG-based planet, star, ring, and wordmark animation. | `src/EmblemCanvas.tsx` |
| Ambient Starfield Background | Canvas-based twinkling stars and constellation lines. | `src/AmbientBackdrop.tsx` |
| Neutron Graph Visualization | Interactive canvas graph with nodes, edges, filters, and pulse effects. | `src/NeutronGraphCard.tsx` |
| Friend Bonus Simulator | Checklist that updates a simulated passport card and tier. | `src/App.tsx` |
| Module Action Deck | Six cards simulating WUNCoin, Connect, Market, Ministries, Orbita, and Civic Pulse. | `src/App.tsx` |
| FAQ Accordion | Expandable questions and answers. | `src/App.tsx` |
| Registration Funnel | Prominent links to sign-in and sign-up flows. | `src/App.tsx` |

### Implementation Highlights

#### Hero Signal Tuner

The hero section includes a tabbed control that cycles through four signals:

- WUNCoin
- Neutron Graph
- Friend Bonuses
- Orbita 3D

This is implemented with local state and a static array of signal objects.

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Signal0
    Signal0 --> Signal1 : user selects
    Signal1 --> Signal2 : user selects
    Signal2 --> Signal3 : user selects
    Signal3 --> Signal0 : user selects
```

Sources:
- [App.tsx](src/App.tsx#L25-L50)
- [App.tsx](src/App.tsx#L246-L272)

#### Neutron Graph Interactions

The Neutron graph supports:

- Clicking nodes to select them.
- Sending impulse pulses from selected nodes.
- Filtering edges by stream type.
- Visual feedback through glowing edges and particle bursts.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  Click["Click Node"] --> Select["Set Selected Node"]
  Click --> Burst["Emit Pulse Particles"]
  Filter["Change Filter"] --> Redraw["Redraw Visible Edges"]
  Select --> Highlight["Highlight Connected Edges"]
  Burst --> Canvas["Update Particle Positions"]
```

Sources:
- [NeutronGraphCard.tsx](src/NeutronGraphCard.tsx#L110-L126)
- [NeutronGraphCard.tsx](src/NeutronGraphCard.tsx#L346-L354)
- [NeutronGraphCard.tsx](src/NeutronGraphCard.tsx#L361-L372)

#### Friend Bonus Passport Card

The friend bonus section calculates a score and maps it to a tier:

| Score Range | Tier |
| --- | --- |
| 0–49 | EARLY VISITOR · TIER I |
| 50–74 | ACTIVE FRIEND · TIER II |
| 75–99 | CORE FRIEND · TIER III |
| 100+ | INNER CIRCLE ALLY |

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> EarlyVisitor
    EarlyVisitor --> ActiveFriend : score >= 50
    ActiveFriend --> CoreFriend : score >= 75
    CoreFriend --> InnerCircle : score >= 100
```

Sources:
- [App.tsx](src/App.tsx#L162-L174)
- [App.tsx](src/App.tsx#L326-L435)

#### Module Simulation Deck

Each module card shows:

- Name and icon.
- Short description.
- Simulated action button.
- Result text shown after interaction.

This is a presentation-only simulation; it does not call backend APIs.

Sources:
- [App.tsx](src/App.tsx#L79-L128)
- [App.tsx](src/App.tsx#L450-L485)

---

## 5. Conclusion and Recommendations

### Summary of Architecture

WUN Gazette is a focused, visually rich React landing page built with Vite and TypeScript. Its architecture is intentionally simple:

- One root component orchestrates sections.
- Visual complexity is delegated to small components.
- Heavy animation is handled directly via Canvas and SVG rather than a heavy UI framework.
- External integrations are limited to authentication and legal pages hosted elsewhere.

### Architectural Strengths

- **Clear separation of concerns:** Each major visual feature lives in its own file.
- **Low coupling:** Components communicate mostly through props and local state.
- **Performance-conscious animation:** Canvas and SVG animations avoid unnecessary React re-renders.
- **Accessible structure:** Semantic sections, roles, aria attributes, and reduced-motion handling are present.
- **Simple deployment model:** Vite + Vercel configuration keeps the build pipeline straightforward.

### Potential Improvement Areas

| Area | Recommendation |
| --- | --- |
| Test coverage | The repository includes only one test file; consider adding tests for state logic and component interactions. |
| Dependency alignment | `three` and `@types/three` are declared but not visibly used in the analyzed files; verify whether they are needed. |
| Styling organization | Consider extracting shared styles into a design token or theme layer if the site grows beyond a single landing page. |
| Routing | If more pages are added, consider introducing a lightweight router instead of anchor-based navigation. |
| Configuration centralization | Environment-specific URLs could be moved to a config module for easier maintenance. |
| Accessibility audit | Add keyboard navigation and focus management for interactive sections like the signal tuner and FAQ. |

### Next Steps for Evolution

1. **Validate unused dependencies:** Confirm whether Three.js is required or can be removed.
2. **Expand testing:** Add unit tests for friend bonus scoring, module simulation state, and Neutron graph interactions.
3. **Improve accessibility:** Ensure all interactive controls are keyboard-accessible and screen-reader friendly.
4. **Document API contracts:** If the site begins calling backend services, document expected payloads and error handling.
5. **Plan multi-page growth:** If additional marketing or product pages are added, introduce routing and shared layouts.

Sources:
- [package.json](package.json#L1-L26)
- [src/App.tsx](src/App.tsx#L1-L571)
- [src/main.tsx](src/main.tsx#L1-L11)
- [src/AmbientBackdrop.tsx](src/AmbientBackdrop.tsx#L1-L102)
- [src/EmblemCanvas.tsx](src/EmblemCanvas.tsx#L1-L378)
- [src/NeutronGraphCard.tsx](src/NeutronGraphCard.tsx#L1-L397)
- [vite.config.ts](vite.config.ts#L1-L7)

</blog>
